text:
olivia_sales: Quick escalation — AuroraTech POC is blocked. SSO token exchange failing against our hosted API and the customer is pushing back on the headline pricing; they say the committed discount threshold wasn't applied. Need an exec touchpoint today to unblock.
mark_solutions: Can you paste the error and the config? short summary is great.
olivia_sales: Error from their side when hitting /v1/generate:\n```\nHTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\nWWW-Authenticate: SAML realm error: assertion consumer mismatch\n{"error":"invalid_sso_token"}\n```\nThey sent SAML metadata; our token broker is returning 401. Also cc'ing pricing — they expect 40% off committed vs. the 25% we quoted.
priya_security: @olivia_sales thanks. Is this the new SP-initiated flow or IdP-initiated? The error suggests ACS URL mismatch. Can you share the SP metadata we provided? Also want to know if they're sending NameID/email or employeeID attr.
olivia_sales: They said IdP-initiated. Attached their fragment in DM. Quick snippet they shared: \n```xml\n<saml:Subject>...<saml:NameID>user@aurora.com</saml:NameID>...</saml:Subject>\n<saml:Attribute Name=\"employeeId\">12345</saml:Attribute>\n```\nThey expect our mapping to accept email and employeeId.
priya_security: Ok. Our broker currently maps primary identifier to email only. We can add employeeId as fallback but need an eng change to token broker mapping. ETA? @ethan_platform
ethan_platform: I can push a quick mapping change to token-broker; it'll be a small patch. Need a confirm on attr names. Dev->staging deploy in ~45m if nothing else in the queue. Note: if we flip mapping live it might require a restart of the broker (2–3 min). We'll coordinate with oncall.
mark_solutions: For exec call, do we need to offer a short-term manual bypass so they can proceed with the POC before the mapping change? Maybe a temporary service account mapping by sales ops.
olivia_sales: Sales ops tried; Aurora wants single-sign on demo using their IdP (no service accounts). They are blocked for the end-to-end demo with CTO tomorrow.
nadia_legal: On pricing, if we change committed discount we need an amendment to the SOW. We can do a 30-day paper to adjust the discount, but finance signoff required. @mark_solutions can you confirm requested discount level and expected ARR so I can loop finance?
mark_solutions: They told me they expect 40% on the first 12 months for the reserved capacity add-on (est ARR $420k). Our standard practice would require a finance review for anything >30% on that ARR. I can draft the amendment text now.
deploybot: [system] Priority label updated: high-priority-deal — flagged by olivia_sales at 1816004335 :rotating_light:
ethan_platform: Two options to unblock faster: 1) quick mapping change (45m deploy) and then scheduled rollback, or 2) stand up a short-lived private token broker in their VPC (longer, needs infra). Recommend option 1 for demo. I'll reserve a deploy window at :50.
priya_security: Opt 1 works but we need to validate logs post-change and rotate any ephemeral credentials. I'll prep a checklist for the post-deploy validation.
olivia_sales: Can we get an exec-bridge at 15:00 PT? CTO asked for a quick call after the demo. Prefer Mark + Priya + Nadia + Ethan to join.
mark_solutions: Free at 15:00 PT. I'll own the bridge and the price amendment note. Nadia, can you be on for contract sign-off guidance? If finance needs to be on, I'll invite.
nadia_legal: I can join. If finance is required, ping @finance_ops and I'll pull them in. I'll draft the amendment language and share before the call.
olivia_sales: Thanks. I'll send calendar invite to Aurora CTO and include the bridge link. Action items: Ethan -> prepare mapping patch (deploy ~:50), Priya -> post-deploy validation checklist, Mark -> amendment draft and finance ping, Nadia -> contract guidance. Will update thread after deploy.
mark_solutions: Also prepping a short one-pager showing the reserved capacity economics and how the 40% would look vs our standard tiers. That should help the CTO decide quickly.
ethan_platform: Deploy done to staging at 1816004722, smoke tests green. Scheduling prod deploy at 1816004900 with a 2 min window. Priya, I'll handover logs stream during deploy.
priya_security: Got it. I'll monitor SAML asserts and token broker logs. If I see >1% failure, I'll abort and roll back.
ethan_platform: Prod change applied at 1816004921. Token broker restarted. No errors in the first 200 requests.
priya_security: Post-deploy validation complete at 1816004960 — SSO flows successful, employeeId accepted as fallback, no credential leakage, rotating ephemeral keys as planned. :white_check_mark:
olivia_sales: Bridge scheduled 15:00 PT. Aurora CTO confirmed. Thanks team — will share notes after call. :pray:
mark_solutions: Great work everyone. I'll upload the amendment draft to the sales folder and ping finance.
nadia_legal: I reviewed amendment — finance ok to fast-track pending signatures. If CTO signs during the bridge we can attach amendment to the POC addendum.
olivia_sales: Closing loop: Aurora did the demo successfully and signaled intent to move to a 12-month reserved pilot contingent on the amended discount. Follow-up thread will track contract sign, implementation timeline, and billing start. I'll create that next.
